items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Recommendation: approve only isolated preview artifacts for complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net; preserve all production, public-launch, monetization, credential, configuration, dependency, telemetry, and deployment gates. Severity: high for production release due to missing control evidence; medium for isolated preview work. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or findings; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; security sitefacts are unknown across 61 managed sites; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, dependency provenance, release controls, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance reports 36 passes, 19 fails, and 6 unknown; complicated.work fails consent/banner checks and deadlymaracas.com is unreachable. No credential exposure or exploit is evidenced, but missing telemetry is not clearance. Exact decision: permit only separate review-worktree previews with deterministic build, link, accessibility, metadata, and smoke validation; do not publish or deploy. Attach dated security/readiness evidence before reconsidering launch.

items.title: Maintain evidence-needed security gate for isolated scaffold previews
items.summary: Security disposition is evidence_needed for the managed fleet. Isolated preview work is acceptable only for complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net; public exposure, deployment, monetization, credentials, configuration changes, dependency additions, new telemetry, and cross-site runtime changes remain blocked until material controls are evidenced.
items.requested_action: Approve preview-only implementation in separate review worktrees with no production exposure. Require dated artifacts covering authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring and incident readiness, and security.txt or disclosure readiness where applicable. Preserve known compliance and reachability failures as blockers; do not remediate production during preview work or claim certification.
